Why is the sky blue?
Sunlight contains all colors. When it passes through the air, tiny gas molecules scatter blue light much more than red, so blue light reaches our eyes from every direction in the sky.

Why do we have seasons?

Because Earth is tilted. As it travels around the Sun, one half leans toward the Sun (more direct sunlight, summer) while the other leans away (winter). In tropical countries like Cambodia, the seasons are mostly rainy and dry instead.

What is gravity?
Gravity is the force that pulls objects toward each other. Earth's gravity keeps us on the ground and makes things fall; the Sun's gravity keeps the planets in orbit.

How do vaccines work?
A vaccine shows your immune system a harmless piece or weakened version of a germ. Your body learns to recognize it and makes defenses, so if the real germ comes later, you can fight it off faster.

What is DNA?

DNA is the instruction book inside almost every cell of living things. It carries the information that decides traits like eye color and helps the body grow and work. It's passed from parents to children.

What causes rain?
The Sun heats water, which evaporates into vapor. The vapor rises, cools, and forms tiny droplets in clouds. When the droplets join and get heavy enough, they fall as rain.

What is inflation?
Inflation is when prices rise over time, so the same money buys less. For example, if inflation is 3% a year, something costing $100 today costs about $103 next year.

What is the Khmer Empire?

The Khmer Empire was a powerful kingdom in Southeast Asia from about the 9th to the 15th century, centered around Angkor in today's Cambodia. It built great temples like Angkor Wat and Bayon, and advanced water systems for farming.

អាណាចក្រខ្មែរជាអ្វី?

អាណាចក្រខ្មែរ គឺជាអាណាចក្រដ៏មានអំណាចមួយនៅអាស៊ីអាគ្នេយ៍ ប្រហែលពីសតវត្សទី៩ ដល់សតវត្សទី១៥ ដែលមានមជ្ឈមណ្ឌលនៅតំបន់អង្គរ។ អាណាចក្រនេះបានសាងសង់ប្រាសាទដ៏អស្ចារ្យដូចជាអង្គរវត្ត និងបាយ័ន ព្រមទាំងប្រព័ន្ធធារាសាស្ត្រសម្រាប់ធ្វើស្រែ។
